messages:
julia: Opened PR #4217 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4217. CI green but merge is gated on RFC signoff. RFC link below. Ping @kevin @omar for reviews. Short: add routing policy config + fallback routing to lower-cost model when capacity tight.

ci-bot: CI checks: unit tests ✅, lint ✅, integration tests: flaky (queued). PR status: checks passing (some flaky tests flagged).

kevin: Saw the PR. Haven't reviewed the RFC yet. Can you paste the RFC link + TL;DR here? Also, any rolling upgrade concerns?

julia: RFC: https://docs.internal.redwood/rfcs/012-routing-policy.md
TL;DR: policy layer for smart routing (latency vs cost), new config schema, route table migration. Rolling upgrade plan: dual-write route table for 2 weeks, then cutover. Expected downtime: none.

omar: From infra side need migration script + rollback. Does the PR include them?

julia: Yes — migration and rollback included under `infra/migrations/2026_03_route_policy.sql`. Quick snippet:
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN policy jsonb DEFAULT '{}';
-- backfill route.policy with default rules
COMMIT;
```

kevin: I'll do the architecture review today. One immediate question: how do we handle prefix cache invalidation for the KV/prefix cache? I don't see docs.

alex: tiny nit in the PR: rename var `route_policy_v2` -> `route_policy`. Not a blocker.

julia: Thanks. @kevin please +1 when done. @omar are you okay with the proposed migration window? If both ok I'll request RFC signoff from reviewers (RFC requires 2 approvals).

kevin: Left inline comments about cache TTL and a suggestion to add a small end-to-end test for the cache behavior. If those are addressed and tests pass I'll approve by EOD.

omar: Infra reviewed migration and rollback. We're good with the timeline and the rollback plan. Approving from infra side. @julia after kevin approves you can proceed to request final RFC signoff.

ci-bot: RFC required approvers: kevin, sara, and pm@product. Current approvals: omar. Waiting on kevin and sara for RFC signoff. Reminder: merging the PR before RFC approvals will be blocked by the repo policy.

julia: Noted. I'll address kevin's cache test request now and ping sara for RFC review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
